propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate gathered requirements from subscription operations and customer success and wrote the user stories and acceptance criteria for the seat-change and invoice-download pages.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the stories and criteria.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The candidate ran acceptance testing for three releases of the billing pages and recorded outcomes in the test log.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the test log document the acceptance testing.

propositions.canonicalProposition: The invoice-download page the candidate specified reduced billing support tickets by 30 percent.
propositions.rationale: The figure is a stand-up remark relayed by the candidate; no ticket report, baseline or period is in the materials.

expectedGap: No ticket report in the materials measures billing support tickets before and after the invoice-download page launched.
expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the stand-up figure out of the evidence; the materials document the stories, the tests and the releases, not a measured change in ticket volume.
permittedFollowUpTargets: Ask for the monthly billing-ticket report with the baseline and the launch date of the invoice-download page.
